_howToUse: Copy to ops/production-launch-evidence.json (git-ignored) and fill it in. EVERY boolean starts false and every evidence field starts REPLACE ON PURPOSE: this file records what a person OBSERVED. A template with pre-filled values would turn the launch checks into a rubber stamp. Flip a boolean only after checking the specific console or run that proves it. If you cannot check something, leave it false and let the verifier report the missing evidence.
recordedBy: REPLACE — name of the person who recorded the operational evidence
recordedAt: REPLACE — ISO date the evidence was recorded, e.g. 2026-07-01T00:00:00Z

backups.lastSuccessfulBackupAt: REPLACE — ISO date of most recent automated backup
backups.restoreTestedAt: REPLACE — ISO date of the most recent completed restore drill (docs/BACKUP.md)
backups.deletionLedgerReconciledAt: REPLACE — ISO date of the most recent zero-blocker quarantined ledger reconciliation

monitoring.pagerEscalation: REPLACE — the actual on-call/escalation path for a production incident

webhookEvents: REPLACE — list the events actually enabled on the Stripe webhook endpoint, read from the Stripe dashboard. Do not copy this list from the events the code happens to handle.
stripe.lastWebhookTestAt: REPLACE — ISO date you last sent a test event from the Stripe dashboard
